jobs.title: Software Engineer III, iOS - Cal AI
jobs.description:
At MyFitnessPal, we believe good health starts with what you eat. We provide tools, resources and support to enable users to reach their health goals.

We are looking for a Software Engineer III, iOS to join the MyFitnessPal Cal AI team. Our users rely on the Cal AI iOS app to power their health and fitness journeys every day. As a member of our Cal AI Engineering team, you’ll have the opportunity to positively impact those users with your expertise in the iOS development ecosystem. In addition to technical expertise, you’ll find that your teammates value collaboration, mentorship, and inclusive environments.

About The Team

Cal AI is our AI-powered food logging experience, helping users effortlessly track their nutrition through meal scanning, smart suggestions, and personalized insights

What You’ll Be Doing

Work closely with our creative design and user interface team to implement native mobile interfaces according to the iOS Human Interface Guidelines
Continually improve the user experience by analyzing and optimizing UI, data storage, and network communications
Independently build and deliver high quality features and improvements
Research and implement high-quality technical solutions to attain business goals that will benefit our continually growing user base
Provide thought leadership on industry best practices around design, testing, security, and deployment
Coach team members to increase the success of the team as a whole
Work closely with your cross-functional product engineering team to solve problems
Turn big ideas into simple, elegant solutions

Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

4+ years of relevant work experience
Applicable experience building applications in Swift for the iOS platform within an Agile environment
Experience writing unit tests and testable code
Experience with multithreaded programming
Comfort working with RESTful APIs
Substantial experience with Git in a team environment
Experience working with a relational database
Past usage of at least one package manager
Some experience with CI/CD
Enjoy working in a collaborative team environment
Excellent communication skills
Excited about the opportunity to mentor junior developers
Demonstrate kindness and empathy

Bonus Points

Experience migrating a large legacy codebase to modern standards
Experience using a functional reactive programming framework (RxSwift, Combine, etc)
Experience using SwiftUI

Values you’ll model

Be Kind and Care — build with empathy; assume positive intent; support teammates and members.
Live Good Health — champion healthy habits and balance in how we work and what we ship.
Be Data-Inspired — ground decisions in research and data; measure what matters.
Champion Change — lean into ambiguity; iterate, learn, and improve continuously.
Leave it Better than You Found It — raise quality, clarify systems, and document as you go.
Make It Happen — bias to action; deliver impact with craft and accountability.

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at MyFitnessPal ranges from $135,000 - $165,000
. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, MyFitnessPal offers a wide range of comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, parental planning, mental health benefits, annual performance bonus, a 401(k) plan and match, responsible time off, monthly wellness and technology allowances, and others.

Exciting Full-Time Employee Benefits, Perks and Culture

Face-to-Face Connections
:
We value personal connections. Enjoy opportunities to meet and connect with your team members in person to help forge meaningful relationships that extend beyond the virtual realm. Teams meet as often as needed and all of MyFitnessPal gathers annually.

Flexibility At Its Best:
Achieve the work-life balance you deserve. Enjoy a flexible time-off policy with our Responsible Time Off benefit.

Give Back:
Use your volunteer days off to support what matters most to you. Each full time teammate receives 2 days per calendar year to give back to their community through service.

Mentorship Program:
Take control of your career through our mentorship program where, if you’d like, you will be matched with a teammate who can help you scale your skills and propel your growth.

Family-Friendly Support
:
Embrace the journey with confidence and care. Enjoy our paid maternity and paternity leave, to provide time to balance family responsibilities with your career and take the time needed to strengthen family relationships. We understand the complexities of starting or expanding a family, which is why we provide best-in-class comprehensive assistance for fertility-related matters.

Wellness Comes First
:
Live Good Health is one of our core values. Receive a monthly Wellness Allowance, empowering you to focus on your physical and mental well-being by choosing from a range of wellness initiatives, including dedicated mental health days.

Celebrate Greatness:
Your hard work deserves recognition! Our reward and recognition platform empowers peers to acknowledge and reward each other for the exceptional contributions they make.

Elevate Your Health & Fitness:
Get access to MyFitnessPal Premium, allowing you to take your fitness, health and wellness journey to new heights.

Unlock Your Potential:
Access our virtual learning and development library, and participate in training opportunities to continuously grow and enhance your skills.

Championing Inclusion
: Our dedicated DEI Committee actively fosters a diverse and inclusive workplace by setting actionable goals and evaluating progress across the organization.

Healthcare Matters:
Your well-being is our priority. Take advantage of our competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits that cater to your holistic healthcare needs. Feel secure and supported on your wellness journey.

Secure Your Future:
Benefit from our retirement savings program, giving you peace of mind for your financial goals. Reach them sooner with MyFitnessPal’s competitive employer match.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Mobile Web — Dots
jobs.description:
About The Team

Dots is building personal AI agents that help people make progress on their goals, including when they are away from ChatGPT. These agents can learn preferences, maintain context, work across applications, and use cloud computers to carry out tasks.

Our team brings together product engineering, design, and research to turn frontier model capabilities into useful everyday experiences. We are defining how people delegate work, understand what an agent is doing, and stay in control. Engineers help shape both the product and the systems behind it, from early prototypes through launch and iteration.

About The Role

We are looking for Senior and Staff Software Engineers to build the mobile web experience for Dots. You will create responsive, accessible interfaces that let people start work, follow progress, and guide their agents from a phone or browser. You will help establish interaction patterns for ongoing, asynchronous work and make sophisticated agent capabilities feel clear and approachable.

In This Role, You Will

Design and ship mobile web experiences for creating tasks, reviewing agent activity, and providing feedback or direction.
Build interfaces that handle streaming updates, long-running tasks, interrupted sessions, and changing connectivity.
Improve responsiveness, loading performance, accessibility, and usability across screen sizes and browsers.
Partner with design and product to prototype interaction patterns that give users visibility and control over agent actions.
Work with backend and full stack engineers on APIs, client state, and reliable synchronization between the interface and agent services.
Own features from exploration and technical design through launch, measurement, and refinement.
Help set frontend architecture and engineering practices while staying hands-on with implementation.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have substantial experience shipping polished web applications, with deep expertise in mobile web development and browser behavior.
Bring strong frontend engineering skills and understand responsive layouts, accessibility, client state, and application performance.
Have built interactive interfaces that stay understandable as data or task state changes asynchronously.
Combine attention to visual and interaction details with sound technical judgment.
Can turn ambiguous product problems into working software and use user feedback to improve it.
Work well with designers, product partners, researchers, and engineers across the stack.
Have led complex projects or influenced architecture while continuing to write and ship code.
Experience with real-time collaboration, offline or intermittent connectivity, or products that help users manage complex workflows is especially relevant.
Prior experience with AI or machine learning is helpful, but not required. We welcome experienced engineers who want to bring strong product and engineering judgment to a new category of software.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

jobs.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking an experienced Software Quality Assurance Engineer
to independently execute and take expanded ownership of quality assurance and test automation activities on the BASIS program. Operating with minimal supervision, the QA Engineer carries direct responsibility for automated test design and delivery, test documentation ownership, defect lifecycle management, and security testing integration - all in support of the program's automation-first QA mandate. All quality assurance activities must be automated.

The selected candidate will independently manage test automation deliverables across Agile sprint cycles, contribute to QA strategy discussions, support junior engineers, and interface with developers and Government stakeholders on quality metrics and release readiness across the deployment pipeline.

This is a 100% remote role.

Test Automation Development & Strategy

Independently design, develop, implement, and maintain automated test scripts for unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end functional testing across the application portfolio.
Ensure all automated test cases are executable by the end of each Agile sprint and fully integrated into the Government-managed DevSecOps pipeline with minimal oversight.
Drive and apply Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodology - authoring test cases prior to code development and collaborating closely with software engineers to align test coverage with functional requirements.
Lead the Test Automation State Assessment for assigned application areas; produce assessment reports with automation completion estimates.
Own the automation of adjacent legacy test cases per Government-approved schedules to systematically expand regression coverage across the portfolio.
Evaluate automation approaches and recommend improvements to test architecture, reusability, and pipeline integration within the Government-provided automation framework.
Serve as a technical resource and mentor to junior QA engineers on automation best practices, test script development, and tool usage.

Test Planning & Documentation

Develop and own Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) at the end of each development cycle/sprint, ensuring full traceability and complete testing coverage of all functional and non-functional requirements.
Document all test activities, execution results, and defect findings within the Government-provided Test Case Management System with accuracy and completeness.
Independently prepare Testing Reports, Release Notes (Draft and Final), and Software Version Descriptions (SVDs) per release cadence requirements.

Quality Assurance & Defect Management

Enforce and monitor hard contractual quality thresholds with zero defects released to production.
Lead defect triage and root cause analysis in JIRA; manage the full escalation workflow to product teams with complete documentation and submit JIRA tickets prior to all escalations.
Own and submit weekly defect escalation reports to customers and the Government Product Owner.

Section 508 / Accessibility Testing

Lead Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility testing at planned intervals throughout the development lifecycle, ensuring continuous integration of accessibility compliance into the QA process.
Own preparation of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) including test results, remediation reports, and conformance level documentation for all applicable deliverables.
Report Section 508 compliance testing status and metrics.

Performance & Environment Testing

Lead stress and load testing activities in the ProdSim (Production Simulation) environment; prepare and submit detailed test schedules for Government approval and execute per approved schedule.
Coordinate and support Disaster Recovery (DR) testing activities in collaboration with technical and operations teams.
Support Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V) of all application prior to production deployment; ensure all IV&V findings are tracked and resolved.

Agile / DevSecOps Participation

Actively contribute to and help facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Maintain sprint-level defect tracking, test case completion status, and burn-down metrics in JIRA; provide QA-focused sprint reporting to program leadership.
Enforce quality gates across the SDLC pipeline; flag and escalate non-conforming deliverables before stage promotion.
Own and submit monthly Quality Status Report (QSR).

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Minimum of 8 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 6 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 3 years with PhD
Must be US CItizen
Able to obtain Public Trust clearance
Cybersecurity workforce certification (e.g., Security+, CASP+)
Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks and scripts using tools such as Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, Cucumber, Python, Java, or equivalent.
Working knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices and their application within Agile sprint cycles.
Proficiency with JIRA for defect tracking, sprint management, and reporting.
Experience developing Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs), UAT plans, and formal testing documentation.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated test integration within a DevSecOps environment.
Experience with Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility testing and VPAT preparation.
Strong communication and documentation skills; ability to report QA status and metrics to program leadership and Government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) Foundation or Advanced Level certification.
Experience supporting DoD or Federal government IT programs with formal QA deliverable obligations.
Familiarity with eMASS and Fortify Software Security Center for vulnerability tracking and POA&M management.
Prior experience in or exposure to DEERS, TRICARE, or other DoD healthcare/benefits systems.
Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 security controls as they relate to application testing and compliance.
Experience with performance/load testing tools and stress test execution in production-simulation environments.
Familiarity with ServiceNow for incident management and tracking.
Experience mentoring junior QA team members and reviewing test artifacts for quality and completeness.

Details

Target Salary Range: $66,000 - $106,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

jobs.description:
Description

Fauna uses simulation to train robots, evaluate their behavior, and develop new capabilities before deploying them in the real world. We’re looking for a Simulation Software Engineer to build the environments, tools, and systems that make this possible—from generating diverse virtual worlds to testing robot behavior and running simulation at scale.

You’ll partner with scientists, robotics engineers, and technical artists to expand what robots can experience in simulation and what our teams can build with it. Your work could span procedural scene generation, automated evaluation, interactive experiences, and remotely hosted simulation. We welcome backgrounds in robotics, real-time systems, simulation, and scalable data infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities

Develop workflows for generating, configuring, and managing diverse scenes, assets, and scenarios.
Extend simulation to support robot capabilities and interactions among robots, people, and dynamic environments.
Make simulation experiments reproducible and easy to inspect, with tools for automated evaluation, debugging, and regression testing.
Build reliable pipelines for generating, processing, and managing simulation data.
Scale simulation through automation, workload orchestration, and remote hosting, supporting both batch workloads and interactive use.
Partner with scientists and technical artists to improve simulation performance, usability, and fidelity to real robot behavior (sim2real).

About The Team

Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’d like to hear from you.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
Experience developing robotics software, simulation systems, real-time applications, or scalable data pipelines.
2+ years of non-internship experience designing or architecting new and existing systems, including design patterns, reliability, and scaling.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with robotics simulation frameworks or real-time 3D engines, such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Unreal Engine, or Unity.
Experience with procedural scene generation, asset management, sensor simulation, or rendering.
Experience with distributed systems, cloud-hosted simulation, or infrastructure for model inference and evaluation at scale.
Experience building evaluation frameworks or tools for inspecting, replaying, and testing complex system behavior.
Familiarity with sim2real transfer, domain randomization, or evaluating robot capabilities across varied environments.
Working knowledge of 3D math, including coordinate transforms, quaternions, and camera models.

Experience identifying, prompting, and implementing AI strategies and recommendations into software development.

Experience with open-source code, communities, and licenses.

We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

As our Senior Software Engineer, you’ll join the Content Delivery Engineering team (CDE) within NBCUniversal’s Global Video Engineering organization in New York City, USA. Your mission is to get involved with delivering outstanding VOD, live event, and linear streaming experiences to millions of viewers across our US, UK, EU, and Africa services - including Peacock, SkyShowtime, Showmax, and NOW/WOW.

You’ll collaborate daily with colleagues across the US, UK and beyond – excellent communication skills are essential. Our team specializes in large-scale Multi-Content Delivery Network design and operations, performance telemetry and analytics, selection & interfacing with content origins via multiple workflows - dynamic ad insertion, manifest manipulation and integrating new player technologies.

Design, develop, and maintain high-performance software systems and features—primarily in Go—used to deliver world-class video content at massive scale for brands like Peacock, SkyShowtime, Showmax, and NOW/WOW.
Build reliable, testable, and user-focused services supporting key streaming workflows, such as VOD, live events, linear channels, dynamic ad insertion, and manifest manipulation.
Participate in thoughtful and consistent code reviews that promote high code quality, clear architectural patterns, and healthy engineering culture.
Partner closely with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to architect systems that are highly available, resilient, performant, and fault-tolerant across multiple regions.
Leverage observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces) and performance analytics to detect issues proactively and drive fast, data-driven root-cause analysis.
Contribute to the design and evolution of multi-CDN strategies, routing logic, and origin workflows that ensure exceptional global streaming performance.
Collaborate daily with engineers across the US, UK, EU, and Africa—requiring clear communication and strong documentation skills.
Influence technical direction, system architecture, and best practices as a senior member of the Content Delivery Engineering team.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on development in Go (preferred) or Python.
Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) using containers and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Strong understanding of CI/CD workflows and experience using Git-based repositories, automated testing frameworks, and build pipelines.
Practical experience with Site Reliability Engineering concepts such as reliability targets (SLIs/SLOs), auto-scaling, distributed systems reliability, or incident response.
Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to articulate design decisions and collaborate with distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with CDNs (e.g., Akamai, CloudFront, Fastly, Cloudflare) or streaming media delivery systems.
Understanding of video streaming technologies such as HLS, DASH, manifests, origins, or content routing.
Experience building systems that support global scale, multi-region deployments, or high availability architectures.

jobs.title: Intermediate Software Developer (Frontend) - Pine Hosting (Remote)
jobs.description:
**About Pine Hosting**

Pine Hosting runs game servers for players and communities: Minecraft, Rust, ARK, Palworld, Project Zomboid, FiveM, Hytale and many more. We don't resell someone else's control panel. We build and maintain our own.

At the center is the Pine Game Panel, our own fork of Pterodactyl that we have built far beyond the original. It handles one-click modpack and plugin installs, a template shop, Minecraft version switching, Steam Workshop collections, DDoS protection management, subdomains and AI-assisted log analysis. Around it sit our Astro website, our WHMCS billing platform, Discord bots and a set of internal tools.

**The role**

We're hiring an intermediate software developer whose main focus is the frontend. You'll own the user interfaces our customers touch every day. That means features in the React panel, pages on the Astro website, and the PHP and HTML templates behind our billing and other systems.

This isn't a junior role. You should be able to take a feature from an issue to a reviewed pull request with little hand-holding. You should also be able to read code you didn't write and know when to ask a question.

Backend experience is a real plus but not required. If you're strong on the frontend and want to grow into full-stack work, we'll train you on our PHP/Laravel backend and the systems around it.

**What you'll work on**

Most of your time goes to the first two areas. The rest grows as you do.

* **Pine Game Panel** (React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, styled-components, easy-peasy, React Router; Laravel API): build and polish customer features such as the file manager, console, backups, schedules, mod and plugin installers, template shop and game-specific settings screens
* **Website** (Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4): product and game pages, pricing, tools and blog; keep it fast, accessible and SEO-friendly
* **Billing and client area** (WHMCS: PHP, Smarty templates, HTML/CSS/JS): customize the client area, order flow and email templates; write hooks
* **Internal tools** (React + Vite; ASP.NET Core): admin dashboards for staff, such as product data, sponsorships and hardware planning
* **Panel backend, as you grow** (PHP 8.2+, Laravel 12, MySQL, Redis, queues): API endpoints, services, background jobs, tests

On the panel, there is also modernization work ahead. Planned items include moving off twin.macro to plain Tailwind, upgrading React and Tailwind, and reworking layouts to be truly responsive. If you enjoy leaving a codebase better than you found it, there's plenty to do.

**What we're looking for**

* Around 2–4 years of professional or equivalent real-world frontend experience, with shipped work you can show us
* Strong React and TypeScript: hooks, component design, state management, and talking to REST APIs
* Solid HTML and CSS fundamentals, with Tailwind CSS experience; responsive layouts, accessibility and cross-browser quirks shouldn't scare you
* Comfort with plain PHP and server-rendered HTML templates, since not everything we run is a single-page app
* Day-to-day Git: branches, pull requests, rebasing, and taking code review well
* Debugging skills: browser dev tools, network inspection, and reading a stack trace in a language you're less familiar with
* Clear written communication in English; much of our work is async through issues and PR reviews

**Bonus points**

None of these are required. Each one helps, and backend experience helps most.

* Backend / full-stack: Laravel or another PHP framework, MySQL, Redis, queues and background jobs, writing tests (PHPUnit, Jest, Playwright)
* Astro or other static and hybrid site frameworks, plus web performance and SEO work
* WHMCS or other billing and client-area customization
* Real-time UIs: WebSockets and streaming data, such as live consoles and resource graphs
* Other languages in our stack: Go (our Wings daemon), C#/.NET (internal tools), Node.js (Discord bots)
* Infrastructure basics: Linux, Docker, nginx, CI pipelines
* Game servers: you've run or modded Minecraft, Rust or similar, so you know what our customers are trying to do

**How we work**

* Work starts from an issue, goes onto a feature branch, and lands through a pull request that a senior developer reviews
* Merged changes deploy automatically to a staging environment, so you test against the real thing before a versioned production release
* Small team, real ownership: what you build is in front of customers within days, not quarters
* Mentoring toward full-stack work, with code review that explains the why

**Details**

* Type: Full-time
* Location: Remote

**How to apply**

When you apply, send links to work you've built, such as a portfolio, GitHub, live sites or a project write-up. Tell us about a frontend problem you solved that you're proud of. Shipped work matters more to us than a list of buzzwords.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: Up to $4,000.00 per month

* Share your Steam profile. What games have you put the most hours into, and have you ever run a server or developed plugins/mods?
* Do you have experience using AI coding agents like Claude Code, Gemini, or Codex inside Cursor or Zed? Tell us how you use them in your development workflow.
* Tell us about a project you're most proud of, whether personal, open-source, or professional. What did you build, what was your role, and what challenges did you overcome? Please share links to your GitHub profile and any portfolio or live projects.

Experience:

* Developer: 2 years (Preferred)

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next-generation AI capabilities.

While autonomous machines offer significant advantages, they also introduce new safety challenges. FORT addresses these concerns by providing solutions such as the Wireless E-Stop, which allows operators to instantly stop any machine from a safe distance, enhancing safety during emergencies.

Additionally, FORT's Safe Remote Control enables operators to manage heavy machinery remotely, reducing the risk of accidents and improving visibility.

By ensuring communications integrity across any network, FORT empowers customers to protect their most valuable assets—people, data, and machines—ensuring they remain safe and secure.

As an Embedded Software Engineer II, you will own specific components of our embedded stack, working close to the hardware on the real-time firmware that our safety devices depend on. Most of your time will be spent in RTOS environments (Zephyr and FreeRTOS) and on bare-metal targets, architecting safety-critical systems where reliability is a hard requirement. You will also work with our Embedded Linux platforms where the two worlds meet, so you will be comfortable moving between constrained real-time targets and richer application environments.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build the Core:** Design and implement robust C/C++ firmware for safety-critical embedded devices.
* **Real-Time Architecture:** Architect and implement RTOS-based firmware on Zephyr and FreeRTOS, including task and scheduling design, ISR handling, inter-task communication, memory and stack budgeting, and deterministic timing analysis.
* **Bare-Metal and Drivers:** Write low-level peripheral drivers and board support code, and bring up new silicon from reset vector through to a running application.
* **Platform Integration:** Interface RTOS devices with our Embedded Linux user-space applications, ensuring reliable communication and consistent behavior across the product.
* **Pipeline & Quality:** Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) to automate testing, including on-target and hardware-in-the-loop test execution.
* **Hardware Integration:** Bring up new hardware, debug complex issues using JTAG/GDB, and optimize for latency, power, and memory footprint.
* **Safety Compliance:** Collaborate with the safety team to ensure code adheres to rigorous standards (IEC 61508) while maintaining development velocity.

**What You Bring**

* **Experience:** 3-5 years of hands-on embedded software development, with a substantial portion on RTOS or bare-metal targets.
* **Core Languages:** Strong proficiency in C, along with working proficiency in C++.
* **RTOS Knowledge:** Solid production experience with an RTOS such as Zephyr, FreeRTOS, ThreadX, or similar, including scheduling, synchronization primitives, and interrupt-driven design.
* **Microcontroller Fluency:** Comfort working directly with MCU peripherals, datasheets, reference manuals, linker scripts, and startup code.
* **Linux Exposure:** Familiarity with Embedded Linux user-space development, sufficient to integrate and debug across the RTOS and Linux boundary.
* **Connectivity:** Familiarity with IP networking protocols and standard interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, USB, CAN).
* **Tooling:** Experience with Python for scripting/automation and familiarity with CI/CD workflows.
* **Debugging:** Comfort using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG, and GDB to troubleshoot hard-to-find bugs.
* **Education:** B.S. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with Zephyr specifically, including devicetree, Kconfig, and west-based workflows.
* Experience with wireless stacks (BLE, ISM, Wi-Fi) on constrained devices.
* Background in Functional Safety (FuSa) or working in regulated industries (Medical, Automotive, Aerospace).
* Low-level Linux knowledge of Board Support Packages (BSP) and device drivers.
* Familiarity with static analysis, MISRA C, or other coding standards used in safety-critical development.

Base Compensation can range from $125,000 to $150,000 based on experience & location.

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

**Project Overview:**

As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections primarily in **Java**, as well as in Python, JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Rust, and Go; evaluating and refining AI-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability; and working with cross-functional teams to enhance enterprise-level AI-driven coding solutions.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Python/Typescript
jobs.description:
### **About Turing**

Turing is one of the world’s leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.

### **About the Role**

We’re looking for experienced, hands-on software engineers to help **evaluate and improve AI coding models**.

Rather than primarily building production applications, you’ll work with coding agents across real-world repositories and assess the quality of their work. You’ll review generated code and agent behavior, determine whether solutions are technically correct, identify failure modes, and create the evaluation signals and feedback used to improve model performance.

**Think of the coding agent as another engineer whose work you’re reviewing:** Can it understand the task? Did it choose the right approach? Is the resulting code correct, robust, and maintainable? Can you explain precisely where it succeeded or failed?

### **What You’ll Do**

* Evaluate AI-generated code and solutions across real-world software repositories
* Review agent behavior, tool usage, and code changes for correctness and quality
* Identify technical errors, weak approaches, and recurring model failure modes
* Compare model outputs and explain why one solution is better than another
* Create and refine rubrics and evaluation criteria for coding tasks
* Produce high-quality evaluation and preference data used to improve coding models
* Build and maintain pipelines and infrastructure supporting data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows
* Synthesize findings from data work into clear write-ups, updates, and recommendations for the team
* Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes
* Share clear, actionable findings with AI researchers and engineers

### **What We’re Looking For**

* **5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience**
* Strong proficiency in **Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or another major production language**
* Experience working in substantial real-world codebases
* Strong code-review skills and technical judgment
* Ability to clearly explain why an implementation is correct, incorrect, or could be improved
* Strong written communication
* Experience using modern LLMs or AI coding tools

Experience with **LLM evaluation, coding agents, RLHF, preference data, rubric design, or post-training** is a plus, but not required.

### **Engagement Details**

* **Compensation:** Market rate; please provide a specific hourly rate expectation
* **Availability:** 40 hours/week preferred, with at least 6 hours of Pacific Time overlap
* **Type:** Independent contractor
* **Duration:** Approximately 3 months
* **Start:** As soon as possible

### **Evaluation Process**

* AI interview (~25 minutes)
* Practical code/AI evaluation exercise (~30 minutes)
* Hiring manager interview (~20 minutes)

The practical exercise focuses on your ability to **review and evaluate AI-generated code**, not competitive programming or algorithm puzzles.

jobs.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
**At Murj, we do what we love and love what we do!**

Murj was founded in 2014 to solve a problem witnessed first-hand. Founder and CEO, Todd, worked with cardiology practices as an implantable cardiac device sales representative for Medtronic. He watched clinicians struggle to manage these sophisticated devices using outdated and inadequate tools. Having previously worked in product management at Apple, Todd knew that brilliant design can profoundly impact the user experience - so why not design a better way to care for patients with implantable devices?

In Murj, Todd created an enterprise SaaS cardiac device management software solutions company that reimagines and transforms patient care through thoughtful design and a passion for quality and a commitment to customer satisfaction. Today, Murj continues this transformative innovation with intuitive, elegant, and imaginative technology solutions that improve the lives of cardiac care professionals and their patients.

**What Murj offers.**

Murj is for people seeking a fast-paced, ever-changing environment surrounded by a supportive team that works hard and strives for innovation and professionalism, with a steady diet of humility and camaraderie.

Every employee is treated like family, with love, respect, and responsibility. The individual and collective success of every employee is at the forefront of what we do and believe.

And in joining Murj, you are joining a community that believes in evolution and promotion from within; there is a high degree of opportunity for progression, creativity, and ownership.

From your first day at Murj, you are eligible for full medical, dental, and vision insurance along with an open vacation policy, more than 10 annual company holidays, and competitive compensation and equity participation, and a 401(k) after 3 months of service.

**How We Work at Murj**

Murj is the right place for people who excel in fast-paced, dynamic environments. Murj embodies a high-performance culture where every team member is expected to exceed expectations and take ownership beyond their role to drive our collective success.

Employees should be comfortable working independently and taking initiative to identify and address needs. This proactive approach is essential to thriving at Murj.

We believe in working hard together, with a shared sense of purpose and drive. We're not afraid to ask tough questions, and we support each other in reaching for bold new ideas.

**Let us leave you with this.**

If this role sounds intriguing - we encourage you to apply. And we encourage applicants to embrace new challenges, as the right fit at Murj is often more about the person and the challenges they seek, not just what they have accomplished in the past.

**About The Role.**

As an SQA Engineer at Murj, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our enterprise SaaS cardiac device management platform. Working closely with Engineering and Product teams, you will focus on end-to-end functional testing, user-level workflow validation, and exploratory testing to safeguard clinical data integrity, interval tracking, and EHR interoperability. You will serve as the advocate for our clinical users, ensuring that every software update delivers a seamless and highly reliable experience for healthcare providers managing life-saving cardiac devices.

**What You'll Do.**

* Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and manual test cases covering functional, end-to-end, regression, and usability testing.
* Validate complex clinical workflows, including patient data processing, transmission triaging, billing interval tracking, and discrete HL7/FHIR EHR data integration.
* Perform non-code-level (black box) functional validation to simulate real-world clinician and administrator usage patterns across the application.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to review requirements, refine user stories, and ensure complete test coverage prior to product releases.
* Identify, document, and track software defects thoroughly using issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira), working alongside developers to verify fixes and ensure high-quality software output.
* Partner with Customer Support to investigate, reproduce, and triage reported production bugs or customer-escalated application issues.
* Participate in release readiness evaluations and sign-off processes for web application deployments and feature updates.

**What Makes You a Great Fit.**

* You have an uncompromising commitment to quality and detail, recognizing that behind every software feature are clinicians and cardiac patients who depend on accurate data.
* You demonstrate strong analytical thinking and curiosity, actively probing for edge cases, unexpected user paths, and system failure modes.
* You take full ownership over software quality, proactively identifying gaps in requirement specifications or test coverage without waiting for direction.
* You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance environment, navigating shifting priorities with adaptability and a solution-oriented mindset.

**What You Bring.**

* 3+ years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance with a strong focus on manual/black box testing of web applications and SaaS platforms.
* Demonstrated experience testing complex workflows, cross-browser performance, and data integration layers.
* Solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and experience working within Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Proven ability to write clear, concise, and structured test plans, test scenarios, and bug reports.
* Exceptional problem-solving skills and strong written and verbal communication abilities.

**Nice To Haves.**

* Experience testing healthcare software, clinical software workflows, or medical device data systems.
* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR) and HIPAA/PHI compliance regulations.
* Experience using Jira

jobs.description:
Overview:

**Job Title: GIS Software Quality Assurance Engineer**  
**Location: Remote**

Mano Lani LLC is seeking an experienced Senior GIS Software QA Engineer to support a U.S. Army program focused on improving the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of installation geospatial and Real Property data.

This position is ideal for a hands-on software quality assurance professional with experience testing GIS applications, validating complex datasets, and ensuring that automated tools produce accurate, repeatable results.

The role supports the development and testing of ArcGIS-based tools, GIS and Real Property data reconciliation workflows, automated validation processes, and geospatial web applications used by Army installation personnel.

The ideal candidate combines strong software testing expertise with practical knowledge of Esri GIS technology, database validation, and test automation. They are comfortable investigating complex data issues, identifying the root causes of software defects, and working closely with GIS specialists, developers, and Real Property analysts to deliver reliable technical solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, document, and execute comprehensive software test plans, test cases, and testing procedures for GIS applications and automated workflows.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and data validation testing to identify software defects and determine their causes.
* Test ArcGIS Pro tools, geoprocessing workflows, GIS data validation processes, and automated reporting solutions.
* Validate the accuracy and integrity of spatial data, geodatabase attributes, field values, and relationships between GIS and Real Property records.
* Test automated business rules designed to identify, correct, and flag inconsistencies in GIS datasets.
* Verify the accuracy of automated Real Property Unique Identifier (RPUID) corrections, missing-attribute population, and exception reporting.
* Test GIS–Real Property alignment tools, automated workbooks, reports, dashboards, and web mapping applications.
* Use SQL, scripts, or other testing methods to compare source data with application outputs and confirm data accuracy.
* Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence.
* Collaborate with developers, GIS analysts, and Real Property specialists to troubleshoot defects and verify corrections.
* Support the development of repeatable and automated testing processes to improve software reliability and reduce manual testing effort

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree in a relevant field of study.
* Software quality assurance: Experience developing and executing software test plans to identify software problems and their causes.
* Technical expertise: Experience and knowledge across key technical tasks and high-impact assignments, with the ability to serve as a technical expert across multiple assignments.
* Esri GIS knowledge: Understanding of Esri ArcGIS application software.
* Army Real Property and GIS knowledge: Understanding of DoD and Army Real Property and Installation Geospatial Information and Services (IGI&S) policies and guidance.
* GIS standards: Understanding of the most recently published DCS G-4 IGI&S Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs) and the current Spatial Data Standard for Facilities, Infrastructure and Environment (SDSFIE) Army Adaptation.
* CAC eligibility: Ability to obtain a Department of the Army Common Access Card (CAC).
* Hands-on experience testing software applications, including GIS-enabled applications, geospatial workflows, or spatial data processing tools.
* Experience creating and executing test cases, documenting defects, conducting regression testing, and verifying software fixes.
* Practical knowledge of ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, or comparable enterprise GIS environments.
* Experience validating database records, application outputs, and complex datasets using SQL or equivalent data-querying methods.
* Ability to test automated data transformations, business rules, field calculations, and reporting workflows.
* Experience with automated testing, scripting, or repeatable data validation processes.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to distinguish software defects from source-data quality issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Testing Esri ArcGIS applications, geoprocessing tools, Python/ArcPy scripts, or GIS automation workflows.

Working with enterprise geodatabases, spatial databases, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, SQL Server, or Oracle.  

* Developing automated tests using Python, Selenium, pytest, Postman, or similar tools.
* Testing APIs, ETL pipelines, system integrations, web GIS services, and dashboards.
* Supporting Army installations, DPW, IGI&S, facilities management, infrastructure, or Real Property systems.
* Familiarity with HQIIS, RPUID, GIS–Real Property reconciliation, and Real Property data quality requirements.
* Experience testing applications where data accuracy, traceability, and compliance with defined business rules are critical.

**Benefits:**
  
Mano Lani LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package including a liberal vacation plan, a matching retirement program, and competitive salaries commensurate with skills and experience. For more information about our organization, please visit our web site at www.manolani.com.

**Physical Requirements:**  
Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time. Position may require typing and reading from a computer screen. Must have sufficient mobility, including but not limited to bending, reaching, and kneeling to complete daily duties in a timely and efficient manner. There is a possibility that due to parking availability and location of work, walking moderate to long distance may be required. Possible lifting up to 25 lbs.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)**
======================================

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today's hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

* Predictable performance, even at scale
* Secure, compliant environments by default
* Real-time observability and profiling built in
* Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
* AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values:

We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

We care for each other.

**Impact of a Software Engineer**
=================================

As a Software Engineer at Upsun, you will build and maintain the backend services behind our customers' billing. Billing is your main focus: invoices, taxes, usage reporting, and the integrations that connect our platform to the commercial systems behind it. These systems handle tens of millions in revenue each year across multiple products, entities, and currencies. Accuracy matters, and your work reaches customers directly.

You will own components in this space and act as a key link between engineering, Finance, and Product. Every new offering Upsun launches needs a billing component, and you will help build it. Over time, you will become a long-term owner of the systems you build. You may also contribute to adjacent services such as project provisioning and account management.

**What to expect**
==================

* **Build billing integrations:** Develop and maintain backend services and API integrations in Go that connect our platform to external billing systems.
* **Ship usage-based billing features:** Build features such as usage tracking, estimates, usage alerts, and invoicing. Work with other engineering teams to understand how new features are measured and charged.
* **Complete billing migrations:** Help finish moving billing to external systems while keeping data accurate and customers unaffected.
* **Troubleshoot and fix issues:** Investigate and resolve billing issues raised by Support and Finance, from incorrect usage data to failed integrations.
* **Protect customers and data:** Contribute to anti-abuse measures and keep security in mind when working with sensitive customer and payment data.
* **Work across teams:** Partner with Finance, Product, and Support, and communicate clearly and asynchronously with a team spread across Europe, North America, and India.
* **Build with good practice:** Write tested, well-documented code, take part in pair programming and code review, and use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully in your workflow.

**What you bring**
==================

* **Go development experience:** 3+ years of professional backend development in Go.
* **Relational databases:** Hands-on experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB.
* **Third-party API integration:** Experience integrating with external REST APIs, including handling errors, retries, and rate limits.
* **Care for accuracy:** Attention to detail in systems where a mistake can reach a customer's invoice, and an interest in concepts like idempotency and consistency in distributed systems.
* **Testing and reliability:** A habit of writing unit and integration tests, including for failure paths, and thinking about how your code behaves in production.
* **Security awareness:** An understanding of common security vulnerabilities and how to avoid them in backend services.
* **Interest in billing:** You enjoy working on billing and financial systems and want to make them your focus.
* **Clear async communication:** You write clearly and collaborate well across teams and time zones.

**Where we hire**
=================

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in **Canada, France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom**. Although we're unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

**How we hire**
===============

We know that a great hire won't meet every requirement that we've outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.

You can expect 3 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you're looking for in your future working environment.

* 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition

* 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager

* 60 Minutes with Team (Pair Programming Session in CoderPad)

Boeing is a globally recognized aerospace leader committed to innovation, safety, and excellence. With a rich history of technological advancements and a focus on shaping the future of aerospace, Boeing serves commercial, defense, space, and security markets worldwide. The company prides itself on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment that encourages collaboration, professional development, and the pursuit of groundbreaking solutions. As a pioneer in aerospace technology, Boeing continually invests in research and development to maintain its position at the forefront of the industry, delivering products and services that inspire and connect people around the globe.

About The Role

We are seeking talented Flight Simulation Software Engineers at various experience levels—Associate, Experienced, and Senior—to join our Flight Simulation Labs team based in Berkeley, MO. This position is integral to supporting Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS), focusing on the development and enhancement of simulation infrastructure and tools that underpin our flight simulation products and systems. The role involves designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software solutions that enable realistic simulation environments for testing and training purposes. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to create core simulation frameworks, develop tools for subsystem message monitoring, and model aircraft capabilities to support constructive scenarios in laboratory settings. This is an excellent opportunity for engineers passionate about aerospace technology and simulation to contribute to projects that ensure the dominance and safety of our platforms over decades to come.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, along with relevant experience in software development. Candidates must demonstrate the ability to obtain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance, which requires U.S. Citizenship. Proven experience in programming languages such as C, C++, C#, Python, Java, or Ada is essential, with a minimum of two years in a software engineering role. Preferred qualifications include active security clearances, experience in defense or avionics industries, knowledge of networking principles, and familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools like Jira. Strong communication skills, the ability to multitask, and a collaborative mindset are highly valued for success in this role.

Responsibilities

Develop, document, and maintain architecture, requirements, algorithms, interfaces, and designs for complex software systems supporting flight simulation infrastructure.
Create and integrate software components to develop fully functional simulation environments aligned with program needs.
Support the development and maintenance of simulation tools used for monitoring, message capture, and subsystem communication within lab environments.
Model aircraft capabilities and develop scenarios to facilitate constructive testing and validation processes.
Collaborate within agile teams to achieve project goals, ensuring timely delivery and quality standards.
Execute research and development activities, documenting findings and integrating innovative solutions into existing frameworks.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of simulation software with hardware and other systems.

Benefits

Boeing offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to attract, engage, and retain top talent. Employees are provided with competitive base salaries and variable compensation opportunities. The company also offers a broad range of benefit programs, including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance, and various paid and unpaid time-off options. These benefits are tailored based on geographic location, tenure, and collective bargaining agreements, ensuring employees receive support suited to their needs. Additionally, Boeing promotes a culture of continuous learning and development, providing opportunities for career growth and skill enhancement.

Equal Opportunity

Boeing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military or veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law. As an SQA Engineer at Murj, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our enterprise SaaS cardiac device management platform. Working closely with Engineering and Product teams, you will focus on end-to-end functional testing, user-level workflow validation, and exploratory testing to safeguard clinical data integrity, interval tracking, and EHR interoperability. You will serve as the advocate for our clinical users, ensuring that every software update delivers a seamless and highly reliable experience for healthcare providers managing life-saving cardiac devices.

Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and manual test cases covering functional, end-to-end, regression, and usability testing.
Validate complex clinical workflows, including patient data processing, transmission triaging, billing interval tracking, and discrete HL7/FHIR EHR data integration.
Perform non-code-level (black box) functional validation to simulate real-world clinician and administrator usage patterns across the application.
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to review requirements, refine user stories, and ensure complete test coverage prior to product releases.
Identify, document, and track software defects thoroughly using issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira), working alongside developers to verify fixes and ensure high-quality software output.
Partner with Customer Support to investigate, reproduce, and triage reported production bugs or customer-escalated application issues.
Participate in release readiness evaluations and sign-off processes for web application deployments and feature updates.

What Makes You a Great Fit.

You have an uncompromising commitment to quality and detail, recognizing that behind every software feature are clinicians and cardiac patients who depend on accurate data.
You demonstrate strong analytical thinking and curiosity, actively probing for edge cases, unexpected user paths, and system failure modes.
You take full ownership over software quality, proactively identifying gaps in requirement specifications or test coverage without waiting for direction.
You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance environment, navigating shifting priorities with adaptability and a solution-oriented mindset.

What You Bring.

3+ years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance with a strong focus on manual/black box testing of web applications and SaaS platforms.
Demonstrated experience testing complex workflows, cross-browser performance, and data integration layers.
Solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and experience working within Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
Proven ability to write clear, concise, and structured test plans, test scenarios, and bug reports.
Exceptional problem-solving skills and strong written and verbal communication abilities.

Nice To Haves.

Experience testing healthcare software, clinical software workflows, or medical device data systems.
Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR) and HIPAA/PHI compliance regulations.
Experience using Jira or similar test management and issue tracking platforms.

First 30 Days: You've completed onboarding, gained a strong foundational understanding of Murj's clinical workflows and system architecture, and integrated into sprint rituals. You are executing existing test cases and participating in release regression cycles.

About SemiAnalysis

SemiAnalysis is an independent research and analysis firm specializing in the Semiconductor and AI industries. We are recognized as the leading authority on the semiconductor supply chain, with the highest concentration of industry experts within one team, and a deep-rooted passion for delving into the intricacies.

Our newsletters reach more than 200,000 subscribers worldwide, including senior management and c-suite leaders at the leading semiconductor and AI companies.

We also offer three core products:

Industry Models – we develop and publish industry models on accelerator shipments, datacentre demand and supply, GPU total cost of ownership, and more. We work with hyperscalers, neoclouds, many of the world’s largest hedge funds, and government agencies.
Core Research – our public equity markets product, geared towards financial investors, distils our deep technical research and knowledge into key insights on technology and product trends.
Consulting and Technical Due Diligence – We conduct custom research and project work to guide key strategic and investment decisions for the largest private equity funds, leading venture capital firms, companies across the AI ecosystem, and government agencies.

Position Overview

We’re hiring a Software Engineer to build and support the dashboards that deliver our institutional models to clients. Our clients use these dashboards to decide what to buy, what to charge, and what to finance. Every dashboard must be as accurate and reliable as the models behind it.

You will work directly with the analysts who build our models across three dashboards:

TCO dashboard: Presents our AI Cloud TCO Model, covering the cost of buying, housing, powering, and financing GPU clusters. It calculates cost per GPU-hour and compares it with rental prices across NVIDIA, AMD, Google TPU, and custom accelerators.
Tokenomics dashboard: Presents our AI Tokenomics Model, tracking revenue, token prices, compute spending, and margins at AI labs and clouds.
CCM dashboard: Presents our Compute Capital and Markets Model, tracking AI financing deals and debt, GPU rental prices, funding costs, and token return benchmarks across neoclouds, hyperscalers, and AI labs.

This is a full-time, remote software engineering role
. You will write code that turns our models into dashboards clients can trust while learning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our team uses AI coding agents every day, and we expect you to use them effectively and check their work.

Responsibilities

Help launch the TCO dashboard, then build new views and features across all three dashboards.
Load new model releases into the dashboards and develop checks to identify errors before clients see them.
Collect and validate data, including component prices, power costs, GPU rental prices, and token prices, while maintaining clear sources.
Work directly with analysts to translate model outputs into accurate, reliable dashboards.
Learn the models well enough to answer client questions about the numbers.
Turn results into charts and short written explanations.
Contribute to newsletter articles, with opportunities for direct authorship.

A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Strong Python or TypeScript skills.
Software engineering experience.
Demonstrated interest in AI hardware, datacenters, or technology markets through projects, coursework, or work.
Ability to use AI coding agents effectively and verify their output.
Strong attention to numerical accuracy.
Ability to learn quickly and revise work based on feedback.
A self-driven approach and pride in the quality of your work.

Deepen your understanding of how institutional models inform client decisions.
