jobs.title: Forward Deployed Agile Software Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Forward Deployed Agile Software Engineer based in United States.

Join a forward-thinking engineering environment where software development, artificial intelligence, and product innovation come together to solve complex business challenges.

In this role, you will work directly with clients to transform ambiguous needs into practical, production-ready digital solutions.

You will design and build AI-powered applications, autonomous agents, intelligent workflows, and full-stack software tailored to real-world business requirements.

Beyond developing models and prompts, you will engineer the systems that make AI applications reliable, secure, observable, and scalable.

Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, you will move seamlessly from technical discovery and rapid prototyping to deployment and continuous improvement.

You will have the opportunity to influence technical strategy, establish engineering best practices, and deliver measurable value across diverse industries.

This role is ideal for a hands-on engineer who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys customer collaboration, and is passionate about bringing emerging AI technologies into production.

Accountabilities

Client collaboration and technical discovery: Partner with clients and internal teams to understand business objectives, operational workflows, technical environments, data sources, and constraints. Translate ambiguous challenges into clear requirements, solution architectures, prototypes, and actionable delivery plans.
AI application and software development: Design, develop, and deploy AI-enabled applications, agentic workflows, APIs, developer tools, data pipelines, and full-stack products that address real business needs.
AI harness engineering: Build the infrastructure surrounding AI models, including prompts, tools, context management, memory, permissions, runtime controls, observability, and feedback mechanisms required for reliable production performance.
Agent orchestration and workflow design: Develop and refine agent loops that support planning, tool selection, execution, observation, reflection, recovery, and termination. Model complex workflows using graphs, state machines, and orchestration patterns that coordinate models, systems, data, and human approvals.
Evaluation and quality assurance: Create evaluation frameworks and testing strategies to measure task completion, accuracy, reliability, safety, latency, cost, and user value. Use representative datasets, regression testing, human review, and production feedback to continuously improve system performance.
Rapid prototyping and product delivery: Build proofs of concept, validate solutions with real users, and transform successful prototypes into secure, scalable, maintainable production systems.
Enterprise integration: Connect AI solutions to client systems, enterprise data sources, cloud platforms, APIs, databases, and third-party services while ensuring compatibility with existing technology environments.
AI safety, security, and reliability: Establish appropriate safeguards, permission boundaries, approval mechanisms, and fallback strategies for autonomous and semi-autonomous systems. Identify and address issues such as hallucinations, prompt injection, context loss, looping, brittle tool calls, and unsafe execution.
Observability and troubleshooting: Instrument applications to capture traces, intermediate states, performance metrics, and failures. Diagnose complex technical and operational issues and use insights to improve reliability and user outcomes.
Engineering excellence: Apply strong software engineering practices across automated testing, documentation, security, version control, observability, and continuous integration and delivery.
Cross-functional communication: Work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, data specialists, security teams, and client stakeholders. Communicate technical decisions, limitations, risks, trade-offs, and progress clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge sharing and innovation: Develop reusable components, technical patterns, and implementation insights that strengthen future projects. Contribute to technical discovery, solution demonstrations, workshops, and pre-sales discussions when needed.

Requirements

Professional software engineering experience: Demonstrated experience building and deploying production-grade software, ideally including AI-powered applications, autonomous agents, or agentic systems.
Programming proficiency: Strong skills in Python, TypeScript, or another programming language commonly used for AI applications, platforms, and developer tooling.
Harness engineering expertise: Practical understanding of how to design the infrastructure, context, tools, permissions, controls, and feedback mechanisms that enable AI agents to operate reliably in production.
Agentic workflow development: Experience building or working with agent loops involving planning, tool selection, execution, observation, reflection, recovery, and termination.
Workflow orchestration: Familiarity with graph-based orchestration, state machines, and multi-step workflows coordinating agents, tools, data, and human approvals.
AI evaluation and testing: Experience designing evaluation systems for AI applications, including task-based benchmarks, regression suites, model-graded evaluations, human review, and production monitoring.
Understanding of AI systems: Knowledge of prompt design, context management, memory, retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, and model selection, including the trade-offs affecting quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
Observability and debugging: Experience instrumenting AI systems to trace decisions, inspect intermediate states, measure quality, and diagnose failures.
Core technical foundations: Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, databases, cloud infrastructure, and modern software development practices.
Problem-solving and adaptability: Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar technologies, business domains, and existing systems, then turn ambiguous customer problems into tested prototypes and production-ready solutions.
Product judgment: Ability to balance model capabilities, reliability, security, latency, cost, maintainability, and user experience when making technical decisions.
Client-facing experience: Experience collaborating directly with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional delivery teams, with the ability to build trust and navigate evolving requirements.
Communication skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain AI behavior, limitations, risks, and technical trade-offs clearly.
Ownership and mindset: A high degree of curiosity, empathy, accountability, initiative, and willingness to work in fast-moving environments where technical constraints and business priorities may change.
Flexibility: Willingness to travel occasionally for client workshops or on-site delivery when required.

Nice To Have

Experience with agent frameworks, workflow engines, coding agents, or custom model-orchestration systems.
Experience building tool interfaces, execution sandboxes, permission models, and human-in-the-loop controls for autonomous or semi-autonomous systems.
Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, knowledge graphs, fine-tuning, and model-routing strategies.
Experience evaluating AI systems using golden datasets, simulators, adversarial testing, online experiments, and production feedback.
Familiarity with AI observability tools and practices, including execution traces, token and cost analysis, latency monitoring, failure classification, and quality dashboards.
Experience developing multi-model systems or specialized agents that collaborate to complete complex tasks.
Understanding of AI security risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, insecure tool use, and supply-chain vulnerabilities.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, as well as containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD tooling.
Contributions to open-source AI infrastructure, evaluation tools, agent frameworks, or related projects.
Experience delivering solutions in regulated industries or complex enterprise environments.
Background in consulting, professional services, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or other customer-facing technical roles.
A track record of taking products from initial discovery through production launch and ongoing adoption.
Claude Certified Architect – Foundations or Professional certification, or an equivalent qualification, supported by practical experience building Claude-based AI solutions, agentic workflows, and enterprise integrations.
Demonstrated experience in agentic AI and harness-driven development, including designing, building, and optimizing autonomous agents, multi-agent workflows, tool integrations, and the harnesses required for reliable, scalable production applications.

Candidates do not need to meet every listed qualification to apply. Professionals with relevant adjacent experience and a strong interest in the role are encouraged to submit their applications.

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Applied AI Scientist — Agentic Decision Systems

Location:
Canada or United States (US time zones)

Experience:
Typically 2+ years of relevant applied work, although we care substantially more about the quality and difficulty of the problems you have solved than the number of years you have been solving them.

About The Role

We are looking for exceptional quantitative thinkers to build agentic systems that help people make better decisions
.

This is not primarily a conventional data science role, an LLM application-development role, or a prompt-engineering role. We are interested in people who want to understand how intelligent systems can reason over complex problems, use tools and models effectively, learn from evidence, and become systematically better over time.

A Central Question In This Role Is

How do we make an agentic system measurably better at the decisions it is intended to support?

That means moving beyond intuition, demos and prompt alchemy. You will think about objectives, observability, feedback, evaluation datasets, statistical uncertainty, experiments, simulation, failure modes and improvement loops. You should be interested not only in building agents, but in developing rigorous ways for those agents—and the systems around them—to improve.

You will work on ambiguous, consequential enterprise problems where the answer is rarely “use an LLM.” Sometimes the right solution will involve an agent. Sometimes it will involve statistical modelling, optimization, machine learning, simulation, rules, or a surprisingly simple piece of mathematics. Frequently it will involve several of these working together.

We want people who are technically ambitious, intellectually demanding, empirically minded and impatient with hand-waving.

What You Will Do

Design and build agentic decision-support systems that can reason over data, interact with tools and models, maintain state, decompose complex problems and support consequential human decisions.
Develop mechanisms for systematic improvement. Design evaluation frameworks, feedback loops, benchmarks, experiments and instrumentation that allow us to determine where a system fails, why it fails and whether a proposed change genuinely improves it.
Turn “make the agent better” into a quantitative problem. Define measurable objectives and failure modes; build representative test sets; analyze performance distributions rather than anecdotes; and distinguish real improvement from movement on a convenient metric.
Explore self-improving agentic architectures. This may involve reflection and critique, adaptive tool or model selection, memory, search, planning, generated training/evaluation data, policy improvement, human feedback, simulation or other mechanisms. We are interested in what works—not in allegiance to a particular architecture.
Bring statistical and machine-learning judgment to agentic systems. Use probabilistic modelling, statistical inference, ML, optimization or causal reasoning when they make the system more useful, more reliable or easier to improve.
Generate high-quality software using AI coding systems. We expect you to work AI-natively. The objective is not to demonstrate how quickly you can type Python; it is to produce excellent software.
Own difficult problems end to end. Work from an initially ambiguous business or decision problem through problem formulation, system design, implementation, evaluation and deployment.
Challenge the problem definition. A technically sophisticated solution to the wrong problem is still the wrong solution. You should be comfortable questioning assumptions and reframing what is being optimized.
Work directly with senior technical and business stakeholders. Explain complex ideas precisely without hiding behind jargon, and make uncertainty, assumptions and limitations explicit.

What We Are Looking For

Exceptional quantitative foundations

You have rigorous training in a highly quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, econometrics, operations research or another discipline involving substantial mathematical and quantitative reasoning.

A master's or PhD is welcome, but neither is a substitute for evidence of unusually strong analytical thinking. Exceptional candidates with a bachelor's degree are equally of interest.

You should be comfortable reasoning mathematically about unfamiliar problems rather than relying solely on methods you have used before.

Experience with agentic systems

You have meaningful hands-on experience designing or developing agentic systems.

We are particularly interested in experience involving some combination of:

multi-step reasoning and planning;
structured outputs and stateful workflows;
memory and context management;
multi-agent or decomposed-agent architectures;
agent evaluation;
automated critique or refinement;
feedback-driven adaptation;
decision-support applications; and
mechanisms intended to improve system performance over repeated iterations.

A chatbot with a system prompt is not, for our purposes, substantial experience building an agentic system. Neither is wrapping an LLM around a vector database and calling the result an agent.

Statistical and machine-learning literacy

You do not need to be a specialist in every branch of machine learning, but you should have enough statistical maturity to reason properly about evidence.

We expect practical familiarity with statistical modelling and machine learning and, more importantly, sound instincts around:

uncertainty;
validation;
sampling and selection effects;
overfitting;
experiment design;
measurement;
predictive versus causal claims;
distribution shift; and
determining whether a system actually works.

You should instinctively ask what the comparison is, how performance is being measured, whether the evaluation resembles the real problem, and how confident we should be in the result.

AI-native software engineering

You are extremely effective at producing software, but we do not
equate software engineering ability with manually writing large quantities of code.

We expect you to use state-of-the-art coding agents extensively—potentially for essentially all implementations.

What matters is whether you can make those systems produce excellent code
.

You Should Be Capable Of

designing a coherent software architecture before or while implementation emerges;
decomposing work effectively for coding agents;
inspecting and interrogating unfamiliar generated code;
identifying bad abstractions, subtle bugs and unnecessary complexity;
designing meaningful tests rather than merely achieving test coverage;
maintaining reproducible environments;
understanding APIs, data pipelines and production system boundaries;
debugging systems whose implementation you did not personally type; and
leaving behind code that another strong engineer can understand, extend and trust.

You are accountable for every line you ship even if you personally typed none of them.

The Intellectual Style We Value

The strongest candidates for this role tend to have several things in common.

They are deeply curious but difficult to impress. They enjoy abstraction, but they want abstractions to survive contact with data. They are happy to propose an ambitious architecture and equally happy to discard it when a simpler system performs better. They distinguish a compelling demonstration from convincing evidence. They are interested in why something works, where it stops working, and what experiment would distinguish competing explanations. They are willing to use LLMs aggressively without anthropomorphizing them or treating their behavior as magic. And when someone says, “This version feels better,” their instinct is to ask: “Better according to what measurement?”

You Will Probably Not Enjoy This Role If

Most of your interest is in conventional analytics, dashboards or notebook-based data science.
Your experience with generative AI is primarily prompting, chatbot development or basic RAG applications.
You prefer selecting an AI framework and following its abstractions to thinking from first principles about the underlying system.
You regard agent behaviour as too unpredictable to evaluate quantitatively or you are satisfied with qualitative demonstrations when controlled measurement is possible.
You believe increasingly elaborate agent architectures are inherently more intelligent.
You enjoy writing code but are uncomfortable delegating implementation to AI systems.
Conversely, you use AI-generated code without wanting to understand its architecture, test its assumptions or take responsibility for its quality.
You need requirements to be fully specified before you can make progress.

Particularly Interesting, But Not Required

Experience with one or more of the following would be especially valuable:

decision science, causal inference, Bayesian modelling or optimization;
reinforcement learning, contextual bandits, simulation or adaptive experimentation;
agent evaluation, observability, benchmark construction or synthetic task generation;
inference-time search, test-time computation, model routing or ensemble systems;
human-in-the-loop or production agent architectures; and
complex enterprise decision environments such as financial services, insurance, supply chain or logistics.

The role is product-oriented: you will shape the capabilities, workflows and evaluation systems that make our agentic products more useful, reliable and improvable.

You will turn difficult enterprise problems, user needs and client lessons into reusable product capabilities. Working with technical, product, domain and client-facing teams, you will identify high-leverage problems, formulate improvement hypotheses, and design experiments that distinguish genuine progress from superficial gains.

We expect you to move quickly from ideas to prototypes and measurable evidence without compromising reasoning, quality or technical integrity. The goal is not to build the most elaborate AI system, but products that make better decisions, whose performance we can understand, and which we know how to improve.

About Mphasis

Mphasis applies next-generation technology to help enterprises transform their businesses globally. Our work combines technology, domain expertise and applied innovation to solve complex problems for enterprise clients.

Summary/Objective

The Quality Assurance Analyst - Patient Support Contact Center monitors and evaluates patient support interactions and case documentation against approved Omega and client quality standards. The analyst reviews accuracy of pharmacy benefit, copay, and claim-support information; patient identity verification and HIPAA/privacy practices; documentation; professionalism; empathy; and adherence to established procedures. The role partners with Operations, Training, and Quality leadership on calibration, actionable feedback, trend identification, and continuous improvement. This position does not make clinical determinations.
Essential Job Functions

Quality Monitoring & Evaluation

Monitor and evaluate recorded and/or live patient support interactions, case documentation, and related workflow activity using approved scorecards and client/program standards.
Assess the accuracy and completeness of information provided regarding copays, deductibles, coinsurance, out-of-pocket responsibilities, eligibility, benefit verification, copay programs, and other assigned patient-support topics.
Evaluate pharmacy claim-support activity for adherence to established procedures, including common rejections, refill-too-soon issues, coordination of benefits, prior authorization status support, plan limitations, and appropriate escalation.
Evaluate patient identity verification, HIPAA/privacy practices, required scripting or disclosures, documentation quality, professionalism, empathy, and adherence to call and case-handling procedures.
Promptly escalate critical errors, compliance or privacy concerns, patient-safety concerns, and material process deviations through established channels.

Calibration, Feedback & Continuous Improvement

Participate in regular calibration sessions with Quality, Operations, Training, and other stakeholders to promote consistent scoring and interpretation of standards.
Provide clear, objective, documented feedback identifying strengths, errors, and improvement opportunities for leader coaching and development.
Analyze recurring quality trends, error patterns, customer-experience themes, and process breakdowns and communicate actionable findings to Quality, Operations, and Training leadership.
Recommend refresher training, job aids, workflow clarification, scripting updates, or process improvements when recurring quality gaps are identified.
Support new-hire nesting, targeted monitoring, remediation efforts, and other quality initiatives while maintaining objective evaluation standards.

Reporting, Documentation & Compliance

Complete assigned quality reviews within established productivity, timeliness, and accuracy expectations and maintain complete audit records.
Track and report quality results, critical-error trends, documentation accuracy, compliance findings, and other assigned quality measures using approved tools.
Maintain confidentiality of patient information, employee performance information, recorded interactions, and audit findings and follow all applicable HIPAA, privacy, information security, and client requirements.
Support internal, client, and program quality reviews by organizing audit evidence, validating findings, and providing supporting documentation.
Follow Omega and client quality policies, scorecards, escalation paths, and security requirements and raise unclear or conflicting standards for review.

Key Success Indicators/Attributes

Complete assigned quality reviews accurately and within established service levels, productivity expectations, and audit schedules.
Maintain strong calibration alignment and apply quality standards objectively and consistently across representatives and interaction types.
Identify critical errors and compliance risks promptly and escalate them with complete supporting documentation.
Produce clear, actionable, fact-based feedback that supports coaching, training, process improvement, and a high-quality patient experience.
Demonstrate strong analytical ability, attention to detail, written communication, and sound judgment when reviewing healthcare, insurance, and pharmacy-support interactions.
Adapt effectively to changes in client requirements, quality standards, workflows, systems, products, and operating procedures.
Maintains confidentiality, professionalism, reliability, and constructive working relationships with Operations, Training, Quality, and other internal partners.

Supervisory Responsibility

None required. This role provides quality feedback and audit findings but does not independently administer discipline or performance-management actions.
Work Environment

This role operates in a professional contact center environment, which may be onsite, hybrid, or remote depending on the assigned program and client requirements. The position routinely uses a computer, telephone/headset, dual monitors, quality-monitoring tools, CRM/case management systems, reporting applications, and multiple client systems and requires sustained attention to recorded interactions, documentation, and data analysis.
Physical Demands

The physical demands are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of this role.
The position primarily involves sitting, listening, speaking, typing, and viewing computer screens for extended periods, with occasional standing and walking.
Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time, non-exempt position. Work hours, time zone coverage, weekend or holiday requirements, and onsite, hybrid, or remote expectations are based on the assigned program and client requirements. Flexibility may be required for calibration sessions, training waves, or other quality needs.
Travel

Regular travel is not expected. Any travel requirement will be based on business or program needs.
Required Education and Experience

High School Diploma or GED required.
Two or more years of experience in a healthcare, pharmacy billing, patient-support, insurance, or similar contact center environment, with demonstrated knowledge of call handling, documentation, quality expectations, or regulated workflows.
Working knowledge of U.S. healthcare insurance and pharmacy-support concepts, including copays, deductibles, coinsurance, out-of-pocket maximums, benefit verification, pharmacy claim responses, coordination of benefits, and common rejection scenarios.
Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to evaluate interactions objectively, document findings clearly, interpret procedures, and distinguish coaching opportunities from critical or compliance errors.
Proficiency with contact center technology, CRM/case management systems, quality-monitoring tools, Microsoft Office applications, and multiple data sources.

Preferred Education and Experience

One or more years of quality assurance, quality monitoring, auditing, coaching, training, or advanced-agent experience in a healthcare, pharmacy, patient-support, or regulated contact center environment.
Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) certification is preferred. CPhT stands for Certified Pharmacy Technician; certification through the Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) or another nationally recognized certifying organization is preferred. Active state pharmacy technician registration or licensure is also preferred where applicable.
Spanish-speaking/English bilingual proficiency is preferred, particularly for quality monitoring of Spanish-language patient interactions and assessing accuracy, professionalism, and clarity in both languages.
Additional post-secondary education, healthcare-related training, quality assurance training, or contact center quality certification is preferred.

Ability to communicate constructively with representatives, supervisors, managers, trainers, Quality team members, and healthcare-related stakeholders while maintaining objectivity and confidentiality.

The Software Engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains software applications using modern programming languages and frameworks. Working in an Agile, globally distributed team, this role partners with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into technical specifications and deliver clean, maintainable, and reliable code.

This individual works with minimal supervision on assigned features, actively learning and adopting the development methods, frameworks, and patterns defined for the role and by the team, and contributes to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems. The role is expected to use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every delivered result.

AI-Assisted Engineering Expectations

Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design, evaluating alternatives, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Development

Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications for assigned features using modern programming languages and frameworks.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, following the team’s established best practices, patterns, and coding standards.
Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Contribute to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems.

Quality and Continuous Improvement

Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, functionality, and maintainability, and seek feedback to continuously improve skills.
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues and bugs in a timely manner.
Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Follow and help reinforce the team’s development processes and standards, helping peers understand the benefits and risks of exceptions.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and methodologies, and stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends.

AI-Enabled Delivery

Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities.
Apply AI-assisted development techniques throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, coding, testing, debugging, and documentation.
Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness before use.
Learn and adopt the prompts, skills, agents, and AI-assisted development patterns defined by the team, and share improvements that benefit the team.
Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.

Governance and Compliance

Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices.
Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.
Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions.

Required Qualifications

2+ years of professional software development experience using languages such as C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript.
2+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft and .NET technologies, specifically .NET Core, C#, and T-SQL.
Experience building RESTful APIs using ASP.NET.
Working knowledge of relational database development, preferably using SQL Server.
Familiarity with testing frameworks (e.g., xUnit, NUnit, MSTest), logging frameworks (e.g., NLog, log4net, Serilog), and ORM frameworks (e.g., Dapper, Entity Framework, NHibernate).
Strong understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures.
Familiarity with Git-based version control (e.g., GitHub, Azure Git) and collaborative coding workflows, including pull requests.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a globally distributed team.
Strong communication skills, openness to feedback, and the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to AI-assisted development platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools.
Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted testing, and AI-enabled software delivery practices.
Experience with front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue), including developing Single Page Applications (SPA).
Experience with additional back-end technologies (e.g., Node.js, Django, Spring).
Familiarity with microservices architecture.
Experience working with NoSQL data stores (e.g., Elasticsearch).
Healthcare domain experience.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

About The Role

We are building something new at System High. As our Quality Assurance Analyst, you will work alongside a small, dedicated product team to test, challenge, and strengthen a new software capability as it advances toward market readiness. This hands-on role offers visibility across the entire development lifecycle, where you will test new functionalities, uncover defects and edge cases, evaluate feature behavior, and collaborate directly with developers and the Product Owner to resolve issues before release. The environment is intentionally lean, requiring you to take ownership, ask questions, and deeply understand how the product works, rather than simply following predefined processes. Candidates with some hands-on software testing experience, an understanding of modern development practices, and a curiosity to discover overlooked issues will thrive in this role.

Qualifications

Hands-on experience with software quality assurance or software testing in a professional, internship, military, academic, or comparable technical environment
Experience performing manual and functional software testing
Proficiency in creating or executing test cases and documenting software defects
Understanding of defect identification, validation, retesting, and regression testing
Familiarity with Git and Git-based development workflows
Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and pipelines
Ability to interpret requirements, user stories, workflows, and expected application behavior
Strong communication skills to clearly report defects and collaborate with developers
Excellent technical documentation skills
Self-discipline, initiative, and ability to manage work effectively in a remote setting
Curiosity and capacity to learn new technical domains from existing documentation

Responsibilities

Collaborate directly with the Product Owner and development team to test functionalities as they progress from development to release
Perform manual and functional testing of new and updated software features
Develop, execute, and maintain detailed test cases and scenarios based on requirements, workflows, and user stories

Identify and document defects, unexpected behaviors, workflow issues, edge cases, and usability concerns, providing clear communication to the team
Validate fixes and perform regression testing to ensure new issues are not introduced

Work within Git/GitHub workflows, including repositories, pull requests, merges, and CI/CD processes
Review automated and unit test coverage, identifying gaps in testing scenarios
Support testing of internal APIs and third-party integrations, including cloud environments such as AWS and Azure
Participate in weekly sprint activities, collaborating within Agile/Scrum frameworks

401(k) retirement savings plan with financial planning guidance
Up to $5,250 annually in tuition assistance for approved courses
Support for professional training and certifications
Company HSA contributions of $600 for individual coverage or $1,200 for family coverage, prorated
Company-paid life insurance, along with short-term and long-term disability coverage

GridPoint is a private equity backed technology leader with a mission to accelerate the world's transition to a sustainable future by creating an intelligent energy network of grid-interactive buildings. Our technology platform harnesses the power and potential within a building to deliver energy, operational, and resiliency benefits — spanning Fortune 500 enterprises, utilities, government organizations, and small businesses.

**About the Role**

GridPoint is hiring a Software Engineer II for the Application Firmware team. You will work in Elixir on the firmware running our in-building energy controllers, the layer between our bare-metal firmware and the GridPoint cloud.

The work varies. A device-side control feature one month, a telemetry pipeline the next, a field failure after that. The target does not vary: constrained hardware installed incustomer buildings, where memory, CPU, and network are all finite.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain features in our Elixir application firmware, from story to release
* Structure application services as OTP supervision trees with isolated, restartableprocesses
* Define and implement device control logic, scheduling, local data collection, andconfiguration
* Develop solutions that function within the memory, CPU, and storage limits of thetarget hardware
* Debug on real hardware: bench units, serial consoles, and logs from the field
* Maintain the interfaces to the GridPoint cloud for telemetry, control, and config sync
* Verify your own work on hardware before calling it ready to ship
* Work with stakeholders to define test plans and develop them alongside the solution
* Work with the Bare-Metal Firmware and Hardware teams on drivers, bring-up, andpower behavior

**Qualifications**

Required

* Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, orequivalent experience
* 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience
* Elixir, or strong functional programming experience and a record of picking up newlanguages
* Understanding of concurrent, fault-tolerant design: processes, message passing,supervision
* Enough embedded or systems background to design within hardware limits
* Comfortable debugging on physical devices, not only locally
* Git-based development and code review

Preferred

* Production Elixir and OTP; Nerves or similar
* Enough C/C++ to read embedded firmware and work with the bare-metal team
* Device telemetry, OTA update, or fleet management
* MQTT, Wi-Fi, cellular, or LoRaWAN
* Control protocols such as Modbus and BACnet, over both serial and TCP
* Energy management, building automation, HVAC controls, or commercial IoT
* Working alongside hardware and QA through bring-up and validation

**What Success Looks Like**

Level II is where an engineer delivers a feature end to end without close supervision. The first year should look roughly like this.

**Milestone** **What we expec**t

3 months Shipping scoped features through normal review; at home in the codebase and on bench hardware

6 momths Owning a feature area from design through field validation; taking part in release validation and triage

12 months Turning vague requests into designs the team agrees on; mentoring newer engineers; trusted to judge release risk

Annual Salary Range: $135,000 to $175,000

### **Position Description: Junior QA Tester – Clinical Data Services**

### **Overview**

The Junior QA Tester will support quality assurance and validation activities for clinical applications and data services developed and hosted for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). This role is focused on hands-on manual testing, ensuring that software releases, data pipelines, and integration services meet functional and data quality requirements prior to deployment.

The ideal candidate will have a solid foundation in manual testing, strong attention to detail, and preferably experience working in a government or regulated environment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Manual Testing and Validation**

* Execute manual test cases and test scenarios for web applications, APIs, and data services.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and system testing.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, and transformations within data pipelines and interfaces.
* Conduct API testing using tools such as Postman or similar.
* Identify, document, and track defects using tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Re-test resolved defects and perform regression testing to ensure issue resolution.

#### **DataClinical Domain Testing**

* Assist in validating data exchange between systems and APIs.
* Support testing efforts involving healthcare data standards such as FHIR or HL7 (preferred but not required).
* Ensure adherence to data security and privacy requirements (e.g., HIPAA).
* Follow established processes for testing within a regulated or government environment.

#### **Collaboration and Documentation**

* Work closely with developers and team members to understand requirements and expected outcomes.
* Participate in Agile team activities (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, etc.).
* Document test results, defects, and testing progress clearly and accurately.

#### **Exposure to Automation (Nice to Have)**

* Gain exposure to basic automation testing tools and frameworks.
* Assist in executing automated tests as needed.

### **Qualifications**

#### **Required**

* 1–3 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance with a strong focus on manual testing.
* Experience executing manual test cases, documenting results, and tracking defects.
* Experience testing web-based applications and/or APIs (REST/JSON preferred).
* Familiarity with defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured testing processes.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.

#### **Preferred / Desired**

* Experience supporting government or federal contracts (VA or other agencies preferred).
* Exposure to healthcare or clinical systems.
* Basic understanding of data formats (JSON, XML).
* Familiarity with API testing tools (Postman).
* Experience working in Agile environments.
* ISTQB Foundation Level or similar certification.
* Ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.

### **Work Environment**

* Remote work supporting VA clinical data services.
* Collaborative team environment with developers, analysts, and stakeholders.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer — Remote AI Code Review
jobs.description:
Junior Software Engineer — Remote AI Code Review is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer-facing AI outputs against real-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap.

**Why this role matters**
-------------------------

Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Junior Software Engineer — Remote AI Code Review assignments.
* Grade junior software engineer engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge-case handling.
* Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed.
* Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric.
* Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off-by-one, security issue) with severity scores.
* Document recurring code-generation failures so the modeling team can target them.
* Calibrate against gold-standard reviews to keep inter-rater agreement above target.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Strong day-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Junior Software Engineer — Remote AI Code Review work.
* Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode.
* Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use.
* Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer.
* Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week.
* Prior code-review or technical-interview-grading experience is a plus.

**Example tasks**
-----------------

* Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it.
* Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge-case bug.
* Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric.
* Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Open-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production-quality code.
* Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides.
* Familiarity with security-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns.

**Skills**
----------

* Code review
* Debugging
* Unit testing
* Software engineering judgment
* Junior Software Engineer engineering review
* Software engineering

**Work model**
--------------

Remote — US-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US.

**Compensation**
----------------

Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process.

**Application process**
-----------------------

Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.title: Pricefx Quality Assurance Engineer - 1099 Contractor
jobs.description:
**Quality Assurance Engineer (Pricefx Implementation) — Contract**

**Position Type: Independent Contractor (1099)**

**Engagement Duration: Anticipated 6 months (subject to project milestones and phase extensions)**

**Estimated Effort: Variable, 20–40 hours/week**

**Location: Remote (US-based)**

**Hourly Compensation Rate: Commensurate with specialized expertise**

**About Canidium**
------------------

**Canidium (an Inc. 5000 company) is a market leader in Sales Performance Management (SPM), Pricing, and Configure-Price-Quote (CPQ) advisory and implementation services. We partner with mid-sized and Fortune 500 enterprises to evaluate, implement, and optimize sales-enabling technologies. We foster a highly collaborative, results-driven, and flexible work environment across our global delivery teams.**

**About the Role**
------------------

**The Quality Assurance Engineer is a hands-on, critical role dedicated to ensuring the quality, functional accuracy, and data integrity of enterprise software solutions built on the Pricefx platform.**

  

**Working inside an Agile delivery team alongside Solution Architects, Configuration Engineers, Integration Engineers, and Project Managers, you will be responsible for validating user stories, verifying complex pricing logic, performing regression checks, and ensuring data transfers across integrated systems meet technical and business specifications. This role requires a blend of analytical thinking, strict attention to detail, strong SQL data validation skills, and experience with enterprise SaaS solutions.**

**Core Responsibilities**
=========================

**Test Planning & Execution**
-----------------------------

* **Review functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to formulate comprehensive test cases and scenarios.**
* **Execute end-to-end functional testing across all project phases, including Sprint Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support, and Post-Go-Live verification.**
* **Verify complex pricing models, rebate structures, price grids, quotes, and analytics logic within the Pricefx application.**
* **Validate data integration pipelines (ETL/REST APIs) between Pricefx and upstream/downstream enterprise systems (SAP, Salesforce, CRM/ERP).**

**Defect Analysis & Reproducibility**
-------------------------------------

* **Identify, document, and track software defects with precision using Jira and modern test management tools.**
* **Ensure every logged defect is 100% reproducible by detailing exact source data, configuration details, step-by-step reproduction instructions, and expected vs. actual outcomes.**
* **Conduct root-cause analysis on test failures and collaborate directly with Configuration and Integration Engineers to verify resolved issues.**

**Requirements Validation & Quality Collaboration**
---------------------------------------------------

* **Critically evaluate user stories to identify logical contradictions, ambiguous edge cases, or missing acceptance criteria prior to build completion.**
* **Assist business users and client stakeholders during UAT by preparing sample test data, test scripts, and guidance.**
* **Maintain and expand a structured regression test suite to support ongoing delivery sprints and platform releases.**
* **Participate in regular defect triage meetings and stand-ups to provide clear quality updates to technical leads and project managers.**

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* **Professional Experience: 4+ years of dedicated experience in software quality assurance and testing, with a focus on enterprise SaaS platforms.**
* **Domain & Application Expertise: Experience testing rule-heavy, data-intensive software applications such as Pricing, CPQ, ERP, or Sales Performance Management solutions.**
* **Data Validation Skills: Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel for backend data verification, source-to-target data comparison, and payload validation.**
* **API & Integration Testing: Proven experience validating Web Services and REST APIs (using tools such as Postman) and JSON/XML data payloads.**
* **Tooling: Hands-on proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and integrated test management systems (Zephyr, Xray, or Azure DevOps).**
* **Communication: Excellent written and spoken English, with a demonstrated ability to articulate technical issues clearly to both technical teams and client stakeholders.**
* **Time Zone Overlap: Ability to maintain at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US business hours.**

**Nice to Haves / Preferred Skills**
====================================

* **Direct hands-on testing or configuration experience with the Pricefx platform (Price Setting, Quoting, Analytics, Rebates).**
* **Formal Pricefx or ISTQB QA certifications.**
* **Experience testing integrations with major ERP or CRM platforms (SAP ECC/S4HANA, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle).**
* **Test automation or comparison scripting experience using Groovy, Python, or JavaScript.**
* **Familiarity with AI-assisted development and testing tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot).**

**How We Interview**
====================

**Our evaluation process is focused on practical capabilities rather than passive resume reviews:**

  

* **Initial Introductory Call: A brief conversation to review your background, communication skills, and engagement availability.**

* **Practical Working Session (45 Minutes): A live practical exercise where you will review a set of sample pricing user stories, evaluate data results, identify logic contradictions, and write up a reproducible defect report using your standard tools.**

**Contractor Compensation & Engagement Terms**
==============================================

**Proposed contract rates for this engagement depend on experience and scope of deliverables. As an independent contractor, services will be provided on an invoice basis without eligibility for employee benefits or bonus programs

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
QA Engineer

  

Toronto, Ontario | In-office | Manual & Automated Testing

  

About the Role

Brainyyack is looking for a QA Engineer to help deliver reliable, intuitive software for our clients.

You will work closely with developers, product managers, designers, and delivery teams to validate

requirements, identify defects, and strengthen quality throughout the development lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role combining manual testing with test automation across web applications, APIs,

and integrations. You will bring a thoughtful, detail-oriented approach to testing, communicate risks

clearly, and help teams make informed release decisions.

  

Location and Work Arrangement

This role is based in Toronto, Ontario, and requires in-office attendance at Brainyyack's Toronto office.

You must be able to commute to the office and collaborate with the team in person.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Review requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria; identify gaps, edge cases, and testability

concerns early.

* Create and maintain test plans, test cases, test data, and traceable coverage of critical business

workflows.

* Perform functional, exploratory, regression, smoke, integration, and cross-browser testing.

* Test APIs and integrations, including authentication, validation, error handling, and data consistency.

* Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, severity, and supporting

evidence.

* Collaborate with developers to investigate defects, verify fixes, and prevent recurring issues.

* Build and maintain automated tests for stable, high-value workflows; investigate failures and reduce

flaky tests.

* Run regression checks within delivery pipelines and support release testing and user acceptance testing.

* Report test results, coverage gaps, and release risks clearly; recommend improvements to testing

practices.

  

Required Qualifications

* Professional experience testing software applications, with a strong foundation in manual testing and

defect management.

* Understanding of the software development and testing lifecycles, Agile delivery, and risk-based testing.

* Ability to design effective test cases using boundary values, equivalence classes, negative scenarios,

and end-to-end workflows.

* Hands-on experience with at least one automation framework, such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.

* Ability to write and maintain test scripts using JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, or C#.

* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman or equivalent tools, with an understanding of HTTP, JSON,

and authentication.

* Working knowledge of SQL for validating records, relationships, and data changes in relational

databases.

* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD concepts, and issue tracking tools such as Jira or Asana.

* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication.

* Ability to work independently, prioritize testing by risk, and collaborate constructively with

cross-functional teams.

* Ability to work in person at the Toronto office.

  

Preferred Skills and Experience

* Experience with insurance products, including claims, policy administration, or adjuster workflows.

* Mobile application testing on iOS and Android, including familiarity with Appium.

* Performance testing with tools such as k6 or JMeter; accessibility testing using automated tools and

manual checks.

* Test management tools such as TestRail, Xray, or Zephyr; CI/CD integration using AWS or GitHub Actions.

* Experience testing AI-enabled features, including inconsistent outputs, failure scenarios, and human

review workflows.

* Use of AI tools to assist with test design or automation, with independent validation and appropriate

handling of confidential data.

* ISTQB certification or equivalent testing education.

  

What Success Looks Like

Well-tested critical workflows, clear and actionable defect reports, dependable automated checks,

and timely visibility into release risks. Consistent collaboration that helps reduce escaped defects and

improve the user experience.
